title: I don’t know if this problem actually matters yet
questionDisplay: I don’t know if this problem actually matters yet
body:
Purpose

  • Reduces premature troubleshooting

  • Builds confidence through deferral

This ANA does

  • Normalize ignoring certain issues early

  • Explain that some problems only matter later

This ANA links to

  • “Keep knitting / don’t adjust yet” guidance

  • Or reassurance-style practice projects

This one is huge for confidence.
